discs.label: Black vinyl
discs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: album web app spinning vinyl asset. Reference image shows the actual black center label from Beyoncé self-titled 2014 12-inch vinyl, NOT the full vinyl disc. Create a physically accurate, perfectly face-on full 12-inch black vinyl record. Black glossy groove field with subtle natural concentric grooves and soft studio reflections, exactly round, evenly lit. Small black center label occupying only 33% of disc diameter; reference pink BEYONCÉ typography and layout on the label, but do not enlarge the label into the groove field. Centered tiny spindle hole 2.5% of outer diameter. Transparent background, no shadows outside rim. Disc fills 92% of square canvas with equal margins. Retain original black pressing appearance; no sleeve, packaging, other objects, tilted perspective, text outside label, or any human figure. Original printed label will be composited back after generation.
discs.notes: Full black groove field/rim reconstructed with built-in image_gen using the official vinyl side A label reference. The original photographed printed label is composited back at 240px diameter with PhotoCraft, retaining title, track lettering and surface texture. A 26px central hub region was filled near-black before the 16px hole to remove the photographed background/large aperture. Groove reflections are approximate; final is explicitly a reconstruction, not an authentic full-disc scan.
discs.processing: PhotoCraft measured ellipse normalization, circle-preserving spindle alignment, opaque 640px circular annulus, centered transparent 16px aperture, centered 648px RGBA lossless WebP with 4px transparent margin.
